# Anthony Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)</sub>
- **Role:** schoolchild  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)</sub>

## Appearance

Anthony has a dark, sullen little face. He has hostile black eyes.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)_

## Personality

Anthony possesses a sullen, mischievous demeanor and displays an impertinent swagger. He dislikes female teachers on principle and holds a contemptuous attitude toward authority. Though defiant and prone to mockery, he usually obeys orders, albeit with a scornful air of toleration.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c12 P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001), [v2 c12 P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023)_

## History

Anthony Pye, an orphan, was taken in by his aunt, Mrs. George Pye, and attended the Avonlea school taught by Anne Shirley. From his arrival, he harbored a prejudice against Anne, believing she was no good like all girl teachers. He frequently engaged in classroom pranks, such as pouring water down Aurelia Clay's neck and placing a lively mouse inside Anne's desk drawer. Though Anne initially strove to win his affection without physical discipline, Anthony's repeated mockery and defiance eventually drove her to whip him with a pointer, causing him to cry.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c5 P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c12 P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 c12 P34](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0034)_
